diagnosis_descriptions: Autism Spectrum Disorder, Level 2 — Requiring Substantial Support

assessments.assessment_name: Verbal Behavior Milestones Assessment and Placement Program
Vineland Adaptive Behavior Scales, Third Edition — Comprehensive Interview Form
Childhood Autism Rating Scale, Second Edition (CARS-2 Standard Form)

skill_acquisition_targets.target_name: Mands for missing items using carrier phrase 'I want ___'
skill_acquisition_targets.notes: Generalized across clinic, home, and community park settings with 3 different adults

skill_acquisition_targets.target_name: Mands for actions using 2-word phrases (e.g., 'push me', 'open please')
skill_acquisition_targets.notes: Emerging with gestural prompt; independent in high-motivation contexts only (swing, bubbles)

skill_acquisition_targets.target_name: Tacts 50 common objects in natural environment
skill_acquisition_targets.notes: Mastered 53 items; generalizes across 2D images, 3D objects, and natural environment

skill_acquisition_targets.target_name: Tacts actions in pictures and videos (e.g., 'running', 'eating')
skill_acquisition_targets.notes: Identifies 8 of 20 target actions; errors concentrated on similar topography actions (jumping/hopping)

skill_acquisition_targets.target_name: Follows 2-step unrelated instructions (e.g., 'clap hands and touch nose')
skill_acquisition_targets.notes: Follows single-step instructions at 90% but loses second step; possible auditory processing component

skill_acquisition_targets.target_name: Parallel play alongside peer for 3 minutes without disruptive behavior
skill_acquisition_targets.notes: Mastered in structured clinic setting; not yet tested in community or school settings

skill_acquisition_targets.target_name: Initiates joint attention by showing or pointing to items of interest
skill_acquisition_targets.notes: Responds to joint attention bids at 60% but rarely initiates; critical ASD core deficit

skill_acquisition_targets.target_name: Independent hand washing with visual schedule support
skill_acquisition_targets.notes: Completed all steps independently; visual schedule faded to last 2 steps only

skill_acquisition_targets.target_name: Tolerates teeth brushing for 60 seconds without crying or turning head
skill_acquisition_targets.notes: Tolerates 40 seconds currently; systematic desensitization protocol in place

skill_acquisition_targets.target_name: Imitates 10 gross motor actions on request
skill_acquisition_targets.notes: Mastered all 10 actions; now serves as prerequisite for motor imitation sequences

behavior_reduction_targets.operational_definition: Any instance of hitting, kicking, biting, scratching, or head-butting directed toward another person's body, with sufficient force to produce an audible sound, leave a visible mark, or cause the other person to vocalize in pain. Includes attempts where contact is made but intercepted by blocking.
behavior_reduction_targets.function_of_behavior: escape from demands; access to tangibles (dual-maintained)
intervention_strategies: Functional Communication Training (FCT) — teaching 'break please' and 'my turn'
Antecedent manipulation — demand fading with gradual increase

behavior_reduction_targets.operational_definition: Repetitive vocalizations that are not communicative in context, including scripting from videos/TV, repetitive humming lasting more than 3 seconds, and echolalic utterances not directed at a communication partner. Scored as percentage of 10-second partial intervals during structured instruction.
intervention_strategies: Differential reinforcement of other behavior (DRO) — 1-minute momentary
Increased opportunities for functional vocal behavior

behavior_reduction_targets.operational_definition: Leaving or attempting to leave the designated therapeutic area (therapy room, fenced playground, or parent-defined boundary) without adult permission, defined as any movement of both feet beyond the boundary or sustained contact with exit points (door handles, gate latches) lasting more than 2 seconds.
intervention_strategies: Environmental arrangement — secured exits with adult supervision
FCT — requesting 'go outside' or 'all done' appropriately
Premack principle — access to preferred outdoor activity contingent on task completion

hours_utilization.explanation_if_low: Family cancelled 4 sessions due to illness (gastroenteritis outbreak at sibling's daycare) and 2 sessions due to caregiver work schedule changes. Make-up sessions offered but not all could be rescheduled within the auth period.

treatment_goals.goal_statement: Client will independently use 2-3 word mand frames to request desired items, actions, and cessation of non-preferred activities across 3 settings with 80% accuracy over 5 consecutive sessions.
treatment_goals.baseline_performance: Client used single-word mands for 12 items with gestural prompts in clinic setting only
treatment_goals.current_performance: Client independently mands using carrier phrase 'I want ___' for 25+ items across 2 settings; 2-word action mands at 55%
treatment_goals.target_criterion: 80% accuracy across 5 consecutive sessions in 3 settings
related_targets: Mands for missing items using carrier phrase 'I want ___'

treatment_goals.goal_statement: Client will engage in reciprocal play interactions with a peer for 5 minutes, including turn-taking and joint attention, with no more than 1 adult prompt per interaction across 3 consecutive opportunities.
treatment_goals.baseline_performance: Client engaged in solitary play only; no peer-directed social initiations observed
treatment_goals.current_performance: Client engages in parallel play for 3+ minutes; responds to joint attention at 60%; initiates joint attention at 20%
treatment_goals.target_criterion: 5 minutes reciprocal play with ≤1 prompt across 3 consecutive opportunities
related_targets: Parallel play alongside peer for 3 minutes without disruptive behavior
Initiates joint attention by showing or pointing to items of interest

treatment_goals.goal_statement: Client will reduce aggression to fewer than 1.0 episodes per hour across all settings for 4 consecutive weeks, using functionally equivalent replacement behaviors.
treatment_goals.baseline_performance: Aggression at 8.3 episodes per hour, dual-maintained by escape and tangible access
treatment_goals.current_performance: Aggression at 2.7 episodes per hour, 67% reduction from baseline
treatment_goals.target_criterion: <1.0 episodes per hour for 4 consecutive weeks across all settings

treatment_goals.goal_statement: Client will independently complete 5 daily living skill routines (hand washing, teeth brushing, putting on shoes, putting on coat, cleaning up toys) with no more than visual schedule support.
treatment_goals.baseline_performance: Client completed 0 of 5 routines independently; required full physical prompting for all
treatment_goals.current_performance: Client independently completes hand washing and imitation tasks; teeth brushing at 60%; shoes and coat not yet introduced
treatment_goals.target_criterion: 5 of 5 routines with visual schedule support only
treatment_goals.modification_rationale: Original goal included 7 routines; modified to 5 highest-priority routines after team discussion with caregivers. Shoes and coat deferred to next auth period to prioritize hygiene routines and safety skills.
related_targets: Independent hand washing with visual schedule support
Tolerates teeth brushing for 60 seconds without crying or turning head

topics_covered: Functional Communication Training implementation at home
Visual schedule creation and use for daily routines
Data collection on behavior frequency (simplified tally method)
Naturalistic teaching strategies during mealtimes and play
Response blocking for aggression — safety procedures
Generalization strategies across home and community settings
Toilet training readiness assessment and initial protocol
caregiver_training.caregiver_skill_acquisition: Primary caregiver (mother) demonstrates FCT implementation with 82% fidelity and correct use of 3-step prompting hierarchy with 88% fidelity. Father participates in alternate sessions and demonstrates prompting at 75% fidelity. Both caregivers can independently implement visual schedules for hand washing and mealtimes.
caregiver_training.barriers_to_participation: Father's rotating work schedule limits attendance to every other session. Family illness (October) resulted in 4 cancelled sessions. Language barrier — sessions conducted in English with occasional Spanish interpretation; bilingual materials provided.

measurable_criteria: Aggression below 1.0 episodes per hour for 4 consecutive weeks across all settings
Elopement below 0.3 episodes per hour for 4 consecutive weeks
Vocal stereotypy below 20% of intervals during structured instruction
Mastery of 80% of current skill acquisition targets with generalization across 3 settings
Caregiver implementation fidelity above 90% for FCT and prompting procedures
Vineland-3 Adaptive Behavior Composite score at or above 70 (current: 62)
discharge_plan.transition_plan: Step-down plan: Phase 1 — reduce to 20 hours/week direct service with maintained supervision. Phase 2 — reduce to 12 hours/week focused on social skills and community integration. Phase 3 — transition to consultation model (5 hours/week) with monthly BCBA check-ins. Final transition to school-based services with IEP consultation.
discharge_plan.current_discharge_readiness: Client has met 0 of 6 discharge criteria. Substantial progress on aggression (67% reduction) and elopement (74% reduction) but not yet at criterion levels. Continued intensive services strongly recommended.

clinical_justification_for_hours: Client's Level 2 ASD diagnosis with co-occurring mixed receptive-expressive language disorder necessitates continued intensive intervention. While significant progress has been made (67% reduction in aggression, 74% reduction in elopement, 5 of 10 skill targets mastered), the client has met 0 of 6 discharge criteria. Ongoing safety concerns (aggression at 2.7/hr), core ASD deficits in joint attention (20%) and social reciprocity, and the need for continued caregiver training support the requested intensity. The Vineland-3 ABC of 62 (1st percentile) confirms substantial adaptive behavior deficits requiring intensive intervention.
confidence_notes: VB-MAPP previous scores not available in document — previous_date listed but scores may have been in a separate report
CARS-2 scoring: raw score of 35.5 places client in 'mild-to-moderate autism' range per manual cutoffs
